inherited.why: The unit converts Figa animation descriptions into AObj/FObj controllers attached to HSD_JObj model nodes, providing a format-specific setup path for hierarchical model animation playback.

links.rationale: Canonical Figa-to-AObj/FObj installation supports per-node model-animation setup. Loaders do not start playback: allocator NO_ANIM persists and supplied flags are masked. Nonpositive or rejected-first-track inputs are unsafe, as recorded in the fact review.
